ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened flat with Bitcoin and Ethereum inching higher while altcoins like Solana, BNB, XRP and Dogecoin slipped modestly. Regulatory momentum is building as the CFTC and SEC push a joint crypto framework, but rising Treasury yields pose a downside risk. Technical optimism returns with Bitcoin flashing a second golden cross, hinting at potential upside if yields stabilize.
